description: Curated held-out golden cases for the article-domain baseline (issue #2516). Content is authored HTML exercising the matching rules on realistic fragments; `surface` is the exact substring the mention occupies (fused prefixes included, as the contract stores it); `expected: held` means an ordinary/homograph surface a curator would suppress — emitting it held is correct, emitting it auto is a precision failure, not emitting it at all is also acceptable. `article_id` is a synthetic key — only the contract shape matters here.

categories.prefixes: Fused inseparable prefixes stripped for the intended name.
categories.quoted-scripture: Vocalized pasuk text quoted inside article prose.
categories.anchors: Names inside existing <a> must never be re-decorated.
categories.homographs: Common words that collide with name spellings — correct handling is held, never a link.
categories.coverage-gap: Names outside the pasuk-corpus gazetteer (recall floor).
categories.ambiguity: Same spelling different referent (ישראל nation, כנען the land).
categories.spelling: Defective spelling vs canonical entry name (ירושלם/ירושלים).
categories.utf16: Astral characters shift span offsets by UTF-16 code units.
categories.ordinary-nouns: Plain prose with no intended mentions at all.

cases.note: אל the preposition is a homograph (name El) — held is correct; לוט and ולאברם are real mentions.

cases.content: כמו שנאמר: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־אַבְרָ֔ם לֶךְ־לְךָ֛ כך דרשו
cases.note: Mixed prose + quoted vocalized pasuk; אֶל־ is the preposition — held.

cases.content: כבר קישרנו אברם וגם פרק יב ועכשיו נזכיר לוט
cases.note: אברם inside the existing anchor must not be re-decorated (invalid nested markup); כבר is an ordinary word held as a homograph.
מלך/אמר/שם/אחר are ordinary words colliding with name spellings — all held; דוד is a real mention.
לבית־אל is one mention of בית אל carrying a fused ל prefix and maqaf; שם the adverb is held.

cases.content: רשי מפרש כי לוט נלכד עם סדם
cases.note: רשי is a rabbinic figure outside the pasuk-corpus gazetteer — recall gap; מפרש strips to the homograph פרש — held.
אור כשדים is not a gazetteer name (the lemma chain never joined it in pesukim) — the compound fragments into held+auto pieces; וגדל is a homograph held.
Pure ordinary prose — אל the preposition is the only homograph, held.

cases.content: בני ישראל יצאו ממצרים לארץ כנען וישבו בירושלם
cases.note: ישראל the nation; מצרים/כנען/ירושלם the lands; ירושלם's canonical key is ירושלים; בני is a homograph (name Bani) held.
The astral emoji shifts mention offsets by one UTF-16 code unit; אמר is a homograph held.

cases.content: האיש הלך לביתו ושתה מים ואכל לחם
cases.note: Zero real mentions; אכל/חם (eat/bread) strip to homograph names — held.
